summary.text: This opportunity briefing combines Gaussian process modeling, Bayesian optimization, and operator learning to address computational bottlenecks in function-space optimization and partial differential equations. By integrating probabilistic surrogate models with operator network backbones, the approach enables uncertainty-aware sequential decision-making. Cited studies demonstrate that such combinations reduce trainable parameters while preserving predictive fidelity and supporting active learning workflows.

riskiest_assumption.text: Given feasibility axis score 2.0, the riskiest assumption is that exact kernel regressions and Gaussian process residual corrections can scale stably to high-dimensional operator network feature spaces without prohibitive computational overhead during active learning iterations.

mvp.text: Build a technical proof of concept using existing packages that couples a deep operator network backend with Gaussian process regression to perform composite Bayesian optimization on a low-dimensional PDE benchmark, measuring training time and predictive calibration.
mvp.type: technical proof of concept from existing packages

success_metric.text: Proposed threshold: a reduction in evaluation budget of at least 20 percent compared to standalone operator network baselines while maintaining calibrated uncertainty estimates on held-out test points.

kill_criteria.text: Proposed threshold: if the computational training overhead of combining Gaussian processes with operator learning exceeds a proposed threshold of 300 percent relative to the base operator network without delivering accuracy gains.

open_source.use: Provides Bayesian optimization routines and Gaussian process infrastructure to guide sample selection and manage acquisition functions.
Serves as a black-box optimization service framework for managing hyperparameter search and trial evaluations.

to_build.text: A bridging module that maps infinite-dimensional function space outputs from operator networks into Gaussian process kernel feature spaces for residual correction and epistemic uncertainty quantification.
